design.title: Layout-preserving descriptor: replace global-average-pooling with a full-receptive-field conv readout
design.eli5: Until now the model summarized each aerial photo like a shopping list: some roof, some road, some trees — without recording how any of it is arranged. Lots of Berlin neighborhoods share the same list, so the model kept mixing them up. We changed the summary step so it works more like a sketch map than a list: it now keeps track of where things sit relative to each other — the road junction in the corner, the long building across the middle. Two lookalike neighborhoods with the same ingredients but different layouts should finally look different to it.
design.hypothesis: The champion's 760.65 m is now bottlenecked by the feature extractor's descriptor, and the history says so twice over. First, exp 5's own pre-registered falsification logic: it exposed 7.5x more distinct training positions (6k frozen -> ~45k with per-epoch resampling) and predicted that if the metric barely moved, data quantity would be exonerated and the extractor/descriptor indicted — the metric moved only 6% (810.02 -> 760.65 m). Second, arch_json across all five experiments shows the Feature extractor is the only inference stage that has NEVER carried changed:true — decode was reparameterized twice (exp 2/3 kept, exp 4 refuted), training twice (exp 3/5 kept), the trunk never once. The defect is structural and quantifiable: the trunk is 4 stride-2 3x3 convs, so each unit of the final 8x8 feature map has a receptive field of only 31 px (~31 m of ground at 1 m/px), and global average pooling then destroys the arrangement of those 64 units — the 128-d descriptor is a permutation-invariant bag of <=31 m local textures. Two Berlin cells with the same ingredients (roof, road, trees) in different arrangements are mathematically indistinguishable to it, and at 760 m ≈ 7 cells the dominant error mode is precisely confusion between distant lookalike cells. Meanwhile 83% of the model's parameters (524k of 630k) sit in the head, downstream of this starved 128-number bottleneck. The fix: replace GAP with a layout-preserving readout — one more stride-2 conv stage (8x8x128 -> 4x4x96) followed by flatten + linear down to the same 128-d descriptor — so the descriptor is computed by weights that see WHERE features sit in the full frame, not just which textures are present. Head, decode, loss, confidence, and the entire training procedure stay byte-identical. This is materially different from refuted exp 4, which bundled a 4x4 spatial descriptor with a 16x16 coarse+offset decode and therefore could not isolate which half failed; here the spatial descriptor feeds the unchanged, twice-validated flat 64x64 classifier, so the descriptor variable is tested alone.
